stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
stimulus: Medieval monks wrote down chants using neumes, small marks placed above the words to show whether a melody rose or fell. The marks did not indicate exact pitches or rhythms, so a singer who had never heard a chant could not perform it from the page alone. ______ monasteries relied on experienced cantors, who taught each new melody to younger singers by ear.
explanation: The sentence before the blank sets out a limit: neumes could not teach a chant to someone who had never heard it. The sentence after it describes what monasteries did because of that limit, which was to have cantors teach melodies by ear. You can put 'so' in the blank and it reads naturally, so you need a cause-and-effect word. 'For this reason' is the only one offered.

A.why: You took the cantors as an example of the notation problem. Teaching by ear isn't one case of neumes being imprecise. It is what monasteries did in response, so it is a result, not an example.

C.why: You read a contrast that isn't there. 'Nevertheless' would mean monasteries used cantors despite the notation's limits. In fact they used cantors because of those limits, so the two sentences point the same way.

D.why: 'Similarly' presents the second sentence as a parallel fact. Relying on cantors isn't another shortcoming like the neumes' vagueness. It is the fix that the vagueness made necessary.

subtype_name: Result of what came before (Thus / Hence / For this reason / As such)

stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
stimulus: In 2019, a traffic study commissioned by the city of Harwell found that nearly two-thirds of its pedestrian injuries occurred at intersections where drivers were permitted to turn right on a red light. The study's authors recommended that the city restrict such turns where foot traffic was heaviest. ______ the city council banned right turns on red at its forty busiest intersections the following spring.
explanation: The first two sentences give the evidence and the recommendation. The last sentence gives the action the council took because of them. 'So the city council banned…' reads naturally, which tells you the relationship is cause and effect. 'Consequently' is the only choice that expresses it.

A.why: 'In contrast' suggests the council did the opposite of what the study advised. It did what the study advised, so nothing in the sentences is opposed.

B.why: You mixed up an example of the recommendation with the result of following it. The ban isn't one case drawn from a larger group. It is the step the council took in response to the study.

C.why: 'Still' signals that something happened despite what came before, which would mean the council ignored the study. The ban puts the recommendation into effect, so there is no reversal here.

stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
stimulus: Glass resists being squeezed far better than it resists being stretched, because tension widens the microscopic cracks on its surface. Makers of tempered glass exploit this principle. They heat a pane until it softens and then blast its surfaces with cold air, so the outer layers harden while the interior is still cooling and contracting. ______ the surface is locked in permanent compression, and the finished pane is roughly four times as strong as ordinary glass.
explanation: The passage explains how tempering works: the surface cools first and the interior then contracts beneath it. The sentence after the blank gives the outcome of that process, a surface held in compression and a much stronger pane. This is mechanism followed by result, so the answer is the cause-and-effect word 'Thus'.

B.why: This is the subtype's trap. The passage states a principle and describes it being applied, so 'for example' can look right. But the locked-in compression doesn't illustrate the process. It is what the process produces, so you need a result word.

C.why: Nothing is contradicted. A stronger pane is exactly what the process is meant to achieve, so a contrast word like 'however' reverses the actual relationship.

D.why: 'Previously' places the compressed surface before the heating and cooling. The compression can only exist after that treatment, so this time word gets the order backward.

stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
stimulus: Fog forms when air near the ground cools to its dew point, the temperature at which water vapor condenses into tiny droplets. On clear, windless nights, the ground gives off its heat rapidly into the open sky, chilling the thin layer of air resting directly on it. ______ low-lying valleys and fields are frequently blanketed in fog by dawn, particularly in autumn.
explanation: The first two sentences explain a mechanism: fog forms when air cools to its dew point, and clear nights chill the air near the ground. The last sentence gives the outcome, fog in low areas by dawn. 'So low-lying valleys are blanketed in fog' makes sense, so the relationship is cause and effect. 'As a result' expresses it.

A.why: 'By contrast' would set the foggy valleys against what came before. Fog is exactly what the passage predicts once the air cools, so nothing is being contrasted.

B.why: 'Admittedly' concedes a point before a reversal, and none follows. The fog isn't a point the writer is reluctantly granting. It is the expected result of the cooling just described.

D.why: You treated the result as an illustration. Foggy valleys aren't a sample of the ground radiating heat. They are what happens because of it, so a cause-and-effect word fits and an example word does not.

stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
stimulus: When a region's largest employer shuts down, laid-off workers who own their homes face a particular obstacle. Taking a job elsewhere usually means selling the house, but the closure has already weakened local demand for housing, so homes can sit on the market for many months. ______ homeowners in such regions tend to remain unemployed longer than renters, who can relocate at far lower cost.
explanation: The sentences before the blank describe a constraint: homeowners can't easily move because their houses won't sell. The sentence after the blank gives the consequence, longer unemployment for homeowners. 'So homeowners tend to remain unemployed longer' reads naturally, so you need the cause-and-effect word 'Hence'.

A.why: The sentence does compare homeowners with renters, so a contrast word is tempting. But the blank links this sentence to the one before it, and longer unemployment follows from the hard-to-sell houses. It doesn't oppose them.

C.why: You mixed up an example of the obstacle with its result. Longer unemployment isn't one instance of houses selling slowly. It is what slow sales lead to, so the relationship is cause and effect.

D.why: 'Similarly' adds a parallel point. Longer unemployment isn't another obstacle like the slow housing market. It is the outcome of that obstacle.
